programme.title: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 3"
programme.desc: The wildlife team comes under attack from an angry rhino after releasing it from its holding crate. Our orphaned baby elephant is settling nicely into his new home and things go crazy when we introduce him to his new playmate, a sheep called Albert.

programme.title: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 4"
programme.desc: Our vet Johan has to run for his life when a darted lion wakes up unexpectedly. The struggle continues to get our baby elephant Themba to drink milk. And the game capture team is tackling the world’s deadliest animal, the hippo.

programme.title: Shark Dive TV S1 - "Hammerhead Sharks"
programme.desc: Shark Dive TV takes a Bull Shark diving trip off the Florida Coast, dives with Hammerhead Sharks in the Bahamas and takes a Deeper Dive studying Great Hammerhead Sharks.

programme.title: Shark Dive TV S1 - "Whale Sharks"
programme.desc: Shark Dive TV dives with Whale Sharks in Mexico, explores a shark hunting ritual 300 Miles off the coast of Costa Rica, and takes a Deeper Dive studying shark attacks, Whitetip Reef Sharks and Oceanic White Tip Sharks.

programme.title: Shark Dive TV S1 - "Endangered Angel Sharks"
programme.desc: Shark Dive TV highlights endangered Angel Sharks in California’s Channel Islands and dives with Reef Sharks in Mexico.

programme.title: Shark Dive TV S1 - "Night Diving with Sharks"
programme.desc: Shark Dive TV features Tiger Sharks, night diving with Sharks, how shark’s smell, how shark coloration works and introduces us to Blue Sharks.

programme.title: Wildlife Heroes S1 - "Birute Galdikas"
programme.desc: Dr. Biruté Mary Galdikas is the leading expert on orangutans, having devoted her life to saving them over the last 50 years.

programme.title: Wildlife Heroes S1 - "Christina Karliczek"
programme.desc: Christina Karliczek Skoglund has been filming animals on land and under water in the most remote places for over ten years.

programme.title: Wildlife Heroes S1 - "Dr. Betsy Fox"
programme.desc: Originally from the USA, Dr. Betsy Fox has lived in Namibia since 1990 and has led an exciting life ever since amongst its wildlife.

programme.title: Wildlife Heroes S1 - "Dr. Rainer Dolch"
programme.desc: Dr. Rainer Dolch is an ecologist who has been living and researching in Madagascar for almost 30 years.

programme.title: Ocean Vet S1 - "The Galapagos Shark"
programme.desc: Follow the team as they risk their lives to transport the shark 10 miles off shore for release in a protected marine reserve.

programme.title: Ocean Vet S1 - "Eagle Rays"
programme.desc: Teaming up with international scientist Dr Matt Ajemian and eagle ray wrangler Chris Flook the team face a tricky task to capture one of the most intelligent fish in the ocean in some of Bermudas most beautiful surroundings.

programme.title: Ocean Vet S1 - "Tiger Taggers"
programme.desc: Follow the team as they struggle to catch and tag the biggest tiger shark they’ve ever encountered as they complete their mission to help study, save and protect this incredible shark species.

programme.title: Wildlife Heroes S1 - "Jonathan Franzen"
programme.desc: Jonathan Franzen, the bestselling author and enthusiastic birdwatcher not only familiarizes us with the birdlife, but also discusses the far-reaching consequences of the drastic decline in birds on a global scale and what we can do to save them.

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel: The Renovation Diaries
programme.desc: The owner of Kestrel Beer buys an original 1930’s Riley Kestrel, with the intention of restoring it and then breaking the land-speed record. This documentary follows the events from restoration to record day.

programme.title: The Ship Sinkers
programme.desc: What fate awaits ships that were once proud vessels at bay, but have now turned into floating junkyards? While one option is to cut them up for scrap, another alternative is to use them to bolster marine biodiversity by turning them into artificial reefs. The old naval ships are sunk to an underwater resting place by ship sinkers.

programme.title: The World of Bridges S1 - "China"
programme.desc: We visit China's most famous Wind and Rain Bridge and the Ponte dei Salti in the Verzasca Valley that literally dates back to the Roman era.

programme.title: The World of Bridges S1 - "Wales"
programme.desc: The Millau Viaduct in the south of France is one of the highest bridge structures in the world while the Pontcysyllte Aqueduct, which stands high over the River Dee in northeast Wales, was built in the 19th century.

programme.title: The World of Bridges S1 - "India"
programme.desc: One of the most impressive steel bridges in the world can be found in Calcutta: the Howrah Bridge. Its predecessor is the Forth Bridge across the Firth of Forth, near the Scottish capital of Edinburgh.

programme.title: The World of Bridges S1 - "Zimbabwe"
programme.desc: The Great Seto Bridge in Japan and the Victoria Falls Bridge in Zimbabwe have more than one thing in common: they were built on dreams and are the only train connections between the two regions.

programme.title: The Chain: How The World Works S1 - "Food"
programme.desc: At the World Food Championships, a $5 burger reveals a massive global chain of space-visible greenhouses, cow rearing, and historic ketchup.

programme.title: The Chain: How The World Works S1 - "Transport"
programme.desc: At a Formula-E race in Chile, we uncover how tree sap, pink lithium lakes, molten rock, and top-secret paint create cutting-edge electric cars.

programme.title: The Chain: How The World Works S1 - "Sport"
programme.desc: Inside LA's SoFi Stadium, a touchdown is made possible by Chinese rare earths, plastic grass, specialized ball factories, and fizzy sodas.

programme.title: The Chain: How The World Works S1 - "Apparel"
programme.desc: At a massive secondhand market in Ghana, the global fashion chain is traced through high-water cotton, stretchy oil denim, and bug-made silk.

programme.title: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1 - "Energy Globe Award - Part 1"
programme.desc: Follow the feature about the 2022 award ceremony for sustainability projects that can change the world.

programme.title: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1 - "Energy Globe Award - Part 2"
programme.desc: Follow the feature about the 2022 award ceremony for sustainability projects that can change the world.

programme.title: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1 - "Fuel Cell Cars"
programme.desc: Learn about fuel cells as a sustainable alternative for cars and mobility in general.

programme.title: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1 - "World Solar Challenge"
programme.desc: Have a look at a solar car competition. Teams from around the world build their own pure solar model and compete in a race across Australia.

programme.title: Women Make Science S1 - "RoboGal (AKA Queen of Robots)"
programme.desc: One of the world’s leading tech developers is creating a new generation of robots designed to help people with everyday tasks.

programme.title: Past, Present, Future S1 - "...of Surgery"
programme.desc: Hundreds of years before antibiotics, the legendary Chinese physician Hua Tuo performed miraculous surgical operations. Today, doctors perform increasingly complex surgery that is only possible with the support of advanced robotics.

programme.title: Past, Present, Future S1 - "...of Sports"
programme.desc: Sports and competitions have always been a core aspect of humanity’s development. While modern sports are evolving thanks to technology, the line between digital and reality has become blurry.

programme.title: Past, Present, Future S1 - "...of Food"
programme.desc: Large factory farms produce food for the masses with one caveat; they’re terrible for the environment. In an attempt to remedy this, chefs and scientists are working together to create a future where what we eat is as sustainable as it is delicious.

programme.title: Past, Present, Future S1 - "...of Comedy"
programme.desc: Comedy has always been a way for people to make sense of the world around them. As the world gets more complicated, how will comedy continue to evolve?

programme.title: Silly Sustainability S1 - "Can You Power A Lawnmower With Grass?"
programme.desc: Andy from the Youtube channel 'How To Make Everything' tests if he can use clippings from mowing his lawn to create fuel that powers the very lawnmower he uses to do so.

programme.title: Silly Sustainability S1 - "Cardboard Lumber Part 1"
programme.desc: In our new series with Andy from @How To Make Everything, we're exploring if household recyclabes can be turned into a lumber substitute.

programme.title: Silly Sustainability S1 - "Cardboard Lumber Part 2"
programme.desc: In our new series with Andy from @How To Make Everything, we're exploring how to mass-produce building materials from household recyclabes.

programme.title: Silly Sustainability S1 - "K-Cups/Recycled Plastic Into Shows"
programme.desc: K-Cups have made our morning routine wonderfully easier, bue we know that they create a lot of excess waste.

programme.title: Quick Connections with Alie Ward S1 - "Living Virtually"
programme.desc: How did the invention of photography lead us to a world where we live entirely virtually? Alie Ward will point us towards a future where we might upload ourselves to the web.

programme.title: Quick Connections with Alie Ward S1 - "Fighting Mortality"
programme.desc: What is the secret to eternal life? Alie Ward goes from an ancient herbal remedy to arrive at embryonic stem cells and the tantalising prospect of a future where we could be forever young.

programme.title: Quick Connections with Alie Ward S1 - "Hacking Happiness"
programme.desc: What could possibly link rockets and antidepressants? Are we on the cusp of having a neural switch that can control our moods? Alie Ward weaves a chain of extraordinary connections.

programme.title: Quick Connections with Alie Ward S1 - "Faking Faces"
programme.desc: Alie Ward falls through the wormholes of history into the Louisiana swamps, then journeys on to discover how poker-faced mischief and a mathematical code for winning games have brought us to machines that can invent very real faces.

programme.title: The Ultimates S1 - "Ultimate Explosions"
programme.desc: Ultimate Explosions chronicles the compelling stories of explosions that have reverberated around the world.

programme.title: The Ultimates S1 - "Ultimate Racing Crashes"
programme.desc: Explore the high tech, high-speed world of car and bike racing.

programme.title: Engineering the Future S2 - "Hyperloop"
programme.desc: Virgin Hyperloop is a train that runs inside a steel tunnel. This revolutionary new vehicle floats along the track using magnetic levitation and glides at airline speeds.

programme.title: Engineering the Future S2 - "The Race to Space"
programme.desc: A new era of space, where small satellites no bigger than a showbox will be deployed not in one or twos, but in their thousands, referred to as satellite swarms.
